definition.time: same30Hz control end; native Pelvis from fourth120Hz substep; target/refV at saved plan age+1
definition.direction: reference velocity norm>=.1m/s; below .1 undefined; actual heading=projected root+X with horizontal norm>1e-12
definition.errors: actual-reference; along reference unit velocity, left=(-uy,ux); XY norms unchanged, no phase search
definition.differences: successive control-end differences, same recorded episode and nonreset only; first/reset null; wrapped heading differences
definition.heading: body root heading versus reference motion direction, not an explicitly commanded AMP yaw
definition.idle: original same-episode previous root displacement speed<.1m/s; all rows remain

limits: Only response associations; no lag search, fitted delay, causal inference or model superiority.
Task observation/actions and reset pre-step root velocity were not independently archived.
Direction-undefined and difference-undefined rows remain in all/phase/failure/contact denominators.
